methods.mean: Unweighted regional mean, never a provincial population-weighted rate.
methods.standardDeviation: Population SD over observed values, denominator=count. For complete candidates count=27; partial-series statistics remain explicitly labelled incomplete and do not establish CORE eligibility.

methods.quartiles: Type-7 linear interpolation at position (n-1)*p, zero-based.
methods.outliers: Outside Q1 - 1.5*IQR or Q3 + 1.5*IQR are screening flags; this list includes extreme points. Outside 3*IQR is extreme. Flags do not establish source errors. No deletion, winsorization, clipping or imputation.

methods.redundancyFlag: abs(Pearson r) >= 0.85 is possible redundancy, never automatic removal.
methods.lowVarianceScreen: CV < 2% together with mean >= 95% for a 0-100 percentage flags possible ceiling compression; practical screen, not universal admission threshold. Interpret absolute range, distribution and concept.
methods.rounding: Statistics computed from original published precision; JSON preserves computational precision, report rounds display only.
methods.missingPolicy: No zero fill, no year substitution, no per-region reweighting.
methods.outlierCaution: IQR0 in saturated electricity yields mechanical fences at100, not evidence of substantive errors.
